text: I'm Ruby's aunt Keisha, Ruby (6) lives with me now. there's a protective order against her mom's boyfriend Travis, he can't pick her up and can't be in the building with her, if u see him call 911. her mom CAN pick her up but Travis can't come with. Ruby has autism, hates hand dryers (covers her ears), and she used to have a nut allergy but she was retested and it's gone, she eats peanut butter now.
